import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0202 {l : List Nat} : List.length (List.filter (fun x => x < 5) l) ≤ List.length l := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0202 {l : List Nat} : List.length (List.filter (fun x => x < 5) l) ≤ List.length l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons x xs => repeat { exact (x < 5) ≤ (x::xs) ≤ (x::xs) + (1 - (x < 5)) }
END BY
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0202 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0202 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0202

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0202
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0202
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
